title: Studio work at Paramount and Ralph Cooper's films
summary: When Ethel Waters took Byas and Glenn from the band, he worked at Paramount Studios with Georgie Stoll and did film work with Ralph Cooper.

story.theme_name: Jazz musicians in the movies and film scoring
story.community_name: Jazz musicians on film and studio scoring

blocks.x: Was that a show band, the band that was coming in there?

Yeah. And they left California so I finally ended up working out at the Paramount Studios with Georgie Stohl, you know, recording for pictures and stuff. And then I did some things with Ralph Cooper when he had his studio out there. And I did a thing called "Bargain with Bullets."
I've seen stills from those movies but I've never seen them.
